title: Drag Sortable
subtitle: Intuitive Drag-and-Drop Sorting for Svelte 5
description: A lightweight Svelte action for drag-and-drop sorting with ghost element, real-time reordering, smooth animations, and full desktop/mobile support.

features.title: Features
features.ghost_element: Ghost element follows cursor during drag
features.desktop_mobile: Full support for desktop and mobile
features.drag_handle: Optional drag handle for precise control

basic.title: 1. Basic Usage
basic.description: Simply drag items to reorder them. All direct children become draggable.

handle.title: 2. Drag Handle
handle.description: Use a specific element as the drag handle. Buttons and inputs remain fully interactive.

animation.title: 3. Animation Settings
animation.description: Customize animation duration for different visual effects.

cards.title: 4. Card Layout
cards.description: Drag and drop works with rich card layouts containing images and metadata.

kanban.title: 5. Kanban Board
kanban.description: Build interactive kanban boards with sortable tasks within columns.

playlist.title: 6. Music Playlist
playlist.description: Create sortable playlists with track information and playback controls.
